descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_advance: Advances the instance's animation time, updates its controller and children, and unregisters it when playback ends.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_owner_flags: Returns the first flag byte reported by the instance's owner object.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_shutdown: Stops and unregisters a mesh instance, detaches it from its owner, and releases its clip, blend and control objects.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_find_clip: Looks up an animation clip by name and stores its index; returns a failure status when no clip matches.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_play_index: Starts an animation clip by index on the controller and registers the instance for updates on first use.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_check_control: Queries the animation controller and returns success only when it reports a nonzero state.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_control_3c: Forwards one call to the animation controller and returns success; its exact role is unclear.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_is_playing: Returns whether the animation controller is still playing (the inverse of its stopped flag).
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_control_34: Forwards one call to the animation controller; its exact role is unclear.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_clip_length_named: Returns a named clip's length, or a default value when the clip is not found.
descriptions.w3d_mesh_instance_clip_length_index: Returns the length stored in the clip entry at an index.
